notes: Each server tag or server can have its own linked kit, and the Link page shows the one you pick.
The sitemap lists the real public pages, including Link, and SEO settings can leave a page out.
A custom page can have its own search title, description, and share image.
Purge cache in the admin header makes a change show on the public site right away.
Opening Tickets no longer traps the admin sidebar, and wipe automations run after an update.
added: A linked kit can apply to a server tag, one server, or the whole site.
SEO settings include a Sitemap list, and each page can be left out.
Public pages tell search engines their official address, and describe the site, the server list, and store products.
The API reference explains the sign-in cookie, a bearer token, and an API key.
Admin has a Purge cache button.
changed: The Link page shows the kit for the tag or server you pick.
The sitemap includes Link and the real store tabs, and leaves out a page that only redirects.
A custom page uses its own title and description. When no share image is set, the site logo is used.
Visitors can zoom the page on a phone.
Purge cache clears the public page copy. That copy otherwise lasts about a minute, or about five minutes on the store.
Opening Tickets no longer blocks the rest of the admin sidebar.
Wipe automations can run, and a site update installs the scheduler that fires them.
Admin routes accept the sign-in cookie. A script can send that cookie or a bearer token.
